name: POND'S Light Moisturiser 25ml Non-Oily Fresh Feel For Soft Glowing Skin With Vitamin E & Glycerin
description:
POND'S Light Moisturiser 25ml – Non-Oily Fresh Feel with Vitamin E & Glycerin

Brand: POND'S
Type: Non-oily face moisturizer
Volume: 25ml
Key Ingredients: Vitamin E and Glycerin
Skin Benefit: Softens skin, improves glow, prevents dryness
Texture: Lightweight and quick-absorbing
Best For: Daily use on normal to oily skin types
Fragrance: Fresh and light

Summary

POND'S Light Moisturiser 25ml is enriched with Vitamin E and Glycerin, offering quick hydration and a radiant glow. Its non-oily, lightweight texture makes it one of the best daily skincare choices at a reasonable price in Bangladesh.

Benefits

Locks in Moisture: Vitamin E and Glycerin keep skin hydrated, soft, and glowing without greasiness.

Lightweight Texture: Absorbs quickly and feels comfortable for everyday wear.

Boosts Skin Glow: Vitamin E improves skin tone, softness, and helps prevent dullness.

Affordable Daily Care: Provides effective moisturization at an attractive price.

Suitable for All Year: Gentle, vitamin-rich formula keeps skin glowing in every season.
